name: March 24, 2026 Regular Meeting
minutes_text:
MINUTES
  MALIBU ARTS COMMISSION
  REGULAR MEETING
  MARCH 24, 2026
  MALIBU CITY HALL, MULTIPURPOSE ROOM
  9:30 A.M.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Vice Chair Cherin called the meeting to order at 9:34 a.m.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Vice Chair Lotte Cherin; Commissioners Maureen Haldeman, Pamela Conley
  Ulich, and Dennis Smith

  ABSENT: Chair Peter Jones

  ALSO PRESENT: Kristin Riesgo, Community Services Director; and Brittany Saleaumua,
  Administrative Assistant

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Commissioner Conley Ulich moved, and Vice Chair Cherin seconded a motion to
  approve the agenda. The question was called, and the motion carried 4-0; Chair
  Jones absent.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Administrative Assistant Saleaumua reported that the meeting agenda was properly posted
  on March 20, 2026.

ITEM 1.  CEREMONIAL/PRESENTATIONS

  None.

ITEM 2.A.  WRITTEN AND ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

  Kerry Knuppe proposed a stage reading of her comedy—thriller, “Moming View
  Drive.” She stated that she had organized a reading in West Hollywood and wanted
  to organize a reading in Malibu.

  Adam Harrison stated he was a painter and created multiple paintings of Corral
  Canyon. He stated his painting titled “Smoke to Stickers” had been exhibited at the
  Frieze Art Fair in 2025, and he would be interested in exhibiting it at the Malibu
  City Gallery.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes of March 24. 2026

ITEM 2.B.  COMMISSION AD HOC COMMITTEE REPORTS

  1.  Arts in Education

  Community Services Director Riesgo stated student poetry workshops had
  concluded, and staff were working on the annual student poetry and art
  anthology. She stated that the annual Poetry Summit would be held on May
  16, 2026.

  2.  Malibu Public Art Exhibitions

  Commissioner Haldeman stated the art exhibition featuring Gay Summer
  Rick was on display.

  3.  Business and Community Outreach

  Commissioner Conley Ulich stated the Malibu Art Association contacted
  her to request promotional assistance for Legacy Park Art Walk events. She
  stated the Art Walk events were on the third Sunday of June, July, August,
  and September.

  4.  Social Media

  No update.

  5.  Community Resilience Proiect

  Community Services Director Riesgo stated Hunter Blaze Pearson was
  commissioned to create a community mural to commemorate the 35th
  anniversary of the City and the 25th anniversary of Chumash Day.

ITEM 3  CONSENT CALENDAR

MOTION  Commissioner Conley Ulich moved, and Vice Chair Cherin seconded a motion to
  approve the Consent Calendar. The motion carried 4-1; Chair Jones absent.

  A.  Previously Discussed Items

  None.

  B.  New Items

  1.  Approval of Minutes
  Staff Recommendation: Approve the minutes for the January 27, 2026
  Malibu Arts Commission Regular meeting and the February 24, 2026
  Malibu Arts Commission Regular meeting.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes 0f March 24, 2026
  Page 3 of 4

ITEM 4  OLD BUSINESS

  Malibu Arts Commission Rules of Procedure and Decorum
  Recommended Action: Adopt Malibu Arts Commission Resolution No. 26-01
  Rules of Procedure and Decorum amending Section 1.1.B. Election of Officers.

  Community Services Director Riesgo presented the staff report.

  Commissioner Conley Ulich proposed revising the Election of Officers to occur
  every 9 months and to coincide with the rotation of each Councilmember. She
  stated that officers should rotate regularly so Commissioners could serve as Chair
  and Vice Chair.

  Commissioner Smith indicated agreement with Commissioner Conley Ulich.

CONSENSUS By Consensus, the Commission agreed to table Item 4.A. until the April 28, 2026,
  Regular meeting to further discuss the election of officers.

ITEM 5  NEW BUSINESS

  A.  Storm Drain Artwork Proiect
  Recommended Action: Review the Storm Drain Artwork Proj ect and determine the
  artwork selection process.

  Community Services Director Riesgo presented the staff report.

  Vice Chair Cherin proposed to select the artist at a Commission meeting.

  Commissioners Haldeman and Smith indicated agreement.

  In response to Commissioner Conley Ulich, Community Services Director Riesgo
  stated that the Art Utility Boxes project was not in the Fiscal Year 2025—26 budget.

MOTION  Commissioner Conley Ulich moved, and Vice Chair Cherin seconded a motion to
  approve the artist for the Storm Drain Artwork Project at a Regular Commission
  meeting. The motion carried 4—0; Chair Jones absent.

ITEM 6  STAFF UPDATES

  Community Services Director Riesgo provided an update on poetry programs and
  Chumash Day.

  Vice Chair Cherin and Commissioner Conley Ulich confirmed they would attend
  Chumash Day.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes 0f March 24. 2026
  Page 4 0f 4

ITEM 7  COMMISSIONER REPORTS, COMMENTS AND INQUIRIES

  Commissioner Conley Ulich recommended two art exhibitions themed generational
  family artists and suggested reaching out to the Brosnan and the Bates families.

  Commissioner Smith stated he was in favor of rotating the Chair and Vice Chair
  every nine months.

  Vice Chair Cherin stated that Commissioners should choose if they want to serve
  as Chair and Vice Chair.

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

  Art Utility Boxes

ADJOURNMENT

  At 10: 19 a.m., Vice Chair Cherin adjourned the meeting.

  Approved and adopted by the Malibu Arts
  Commission of the City of Malibu on May 26,
